script_text:
Stop! Scorpio, the stars are screaming very loud and clear right now.

Mars, your ruling planet, and Pluto, your modern co-ruler, are forming a tense square in your watery 8th House of secrets and painful rebirth. This creates friction in your deepest emotional underworld.

Love this hour: If partnered, Mars squares Pluto in your 7th House, so intimacy may trigger old power struggles; if single, this Mars-Pluto tension in your 6th House pushes you to heal self-undoing habits before attracting a magnetic healer or crisis partner.

Career and money: Pluto in your 10th House of reputation brings a hidden power struggle at work; avoid decisions under pressure and channel that Mars-Pluto force into strategic reinvention and bold self-expression.

Warning or blessing: Avoid signing contracts or sharing bank details, but an unexpected private payout or offer arrives soon.

Follow for tomorrow's reading.
